svg.title: Return credit and refund accounting evidence
svg.desc: Return credit and refund accounting evidence. Stored line and header references connect return evidence to credit and optional refund records. Return, credit memo, and refund each have an independent type-qualified posting route. Read each numbered connector with its evidence explanation. Reference paths are not a time sequence; analytical support and account effects do not create additional stored keys.
